        slack = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
        width = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
        floor_diff = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
        dist_pd = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)

            p = inst.V_p[k]
            d = inst.V_d[k]

            jd = inst.jobs[d]

            ld[k] = Float64(inst.l[d])
            slack[k] = Float64(inst.l[d] - inst.e[p])
            width[k] = Float64((inst.l[p] - inst.e[p]) + (inst.l[d] - inst.e[d]))
            floor_diff[k] = Float64(abs(Int64(jp.point.z) - Int64(jd.point.z)))

            dx = Float64(jp.point.x - jd.point.x)
            dy = Float64(jp.point.y - jd.point.y)
            dist_pd[k] = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
        end

        min_ep, max_ep = minimum(ep), maximum(ep)
        min_ld, max_ld = minimum(ld), maximum(ld)
        min_sl, max_sl = minimum(slack), maximum(slack)
        min_w,  max_w  = minimum(width), maximum(width)
        min_fl, max_fl = minimum(floor_diff), maximum(floor_diff)
        min_di, max_di = minimum(dist_pd), maximum(dist_pd)

        rng_ep = max_ep - min_ep + 1e-5
        rng_ld = max_ld - min_ld + 1e-5
        rng_sl = max_sl - min_sl + 1e-5
        rng_w  = max_w  - min_w  + 1e-5
        rng_fl = max_fl - min_fl + 1e-5
        rng_di = max_di - min_di + 1e-5

        w_urgency  = rand(params.rng) * 2.0
        w_deadline = rand(params.rng) * 2.0

            u_sl = 1.0 - (slack[k] - min_sl) / rng_sl
            u_w  = 1.0 - (width[k] - min_w) / rng_w
            u_fl = (floor_diff[k] - min_fl) / rng_fl
            u_di = (dist_pd[k] - min_di) / rng_di

            noise = rand(params.rng) * 0.1
            scores[k] = w_urgency * u_ep + w_deadline * u_ld + w_slack * u_sl +

        end

        w_earliest = rand(params.rng) * 1.5

        end

        perm = sortperm(scores, rev=true)
        result = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
        @inbounds for k in 1:n

    else
        # Mode 3: Dynamic Spatio-Temporal Nearest-Neighbor Chain

        py = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)

        dy = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
        dz = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
        ep = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
        ld = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)

        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            p = inst.V_p[k]
            d = inst.V_d[k]
            jp = inst.jobs[p]
            jd = inst.jobs[d]

            dx[k] = Float64(jd.point.x)

        visited = fill(false, n)
        order = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)

        best_init_score = Inf

        order[1] = start_k

        w_time  = 0.1 + rand(params.rng) * 0.4
        w_dist  = 0.01 + rand(params.rng) * 0.04

        @inbounds for step in 2:n

        slack_k = ld[k] - ep[k]

            best_cost = Inf

                    f_pen = (pz[k] != dz[prev]) ? beta_floor : 0.0
                    jitter = rand(params.rng) * 0.1

                end
            end

            order[step] = best_k
            visited[best_k] = true
        end

        result = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            result[k] = Int64(inst.V_p[order[k]])
        end

        jitter_scale = 0.02 + rand(params.rng) * 0.08

        @inbounds for k in 1:n

function llm_candidate_score(inst::InstanceData, params::ParameterData)::Vector{Int64}
    n = inst.n
    if n <= 1
        return Vector{Int64}(inst.V_p)
    end

    f1 = Vector{Float64}(undef, n) # ep (earliest pickup time)
    f2 = Vector{Float64}(undef, n) # span (ld - ep)
    f3 = Vector{Float64}(undef, n) # tw_p (lp - ep)
    f4 = Vector{Float64}(undef, n) # spatial distance (pickup to delivery)
    f5 = Vector{Float64}(undef, n) # cross-island indicator
    f6 = Vector{Float64}(undef, n) # pickup demand

    pz = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)

    @inbounds for k in 1:n
        p = inst.V_p[k]
        d = inst.V_d[k]

        jp = inst.jobs[p]
        jd = inst.jobs[d]

        ep_val = Float64(inst.e[p])
        lp_val = Float64(inst.l[p])
        ld_val = Float64(inst.l[d])

        dx = Float64(jp.point.x - jd.point.x)
        dy = Float64(jp.point.y - jd.point.y)
        dist_val = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)

        p_z = Int64(jp.point.z)
        d_z = Int64(jd.point.z)

        pz[k] = p_z

        f1[k] = ep_val
        f2[k] = ld_val - ep_val
        f3[k] = lp_val - ep_val
        f4[k] = dist_val
        f5[k] = (p_z != d_z) ? 1.0 : 0.0
        f6[k] = Float64(inst.q[p])
    end

    # Normalize features to [0, 1] for balanced combination
    min1, max1 = f1[1], f1[1]
    min2, max2 = f2[1], f2[1]
    min3, max3 = f3[1], f3[1]
    min4, max4 = f4[1], f4[1]
    min6, max6 = f6[1], f6[1]

    @inbounds for k in 2:n
        if f1[k] < min1; min1 = f1[k]; end
        if f1[k] > max1; max1 = f1[k]; end

        if f2[k] < min2; min2 = f2[k]; end
        if f2[k] > max2; max2 = f2[k]; end

        if f3[k] < min3; min3 = f3[k]; end
        if f3[k] > max3; max3 = f3[k]; end

        if f4[k] < min4; min4 = f4[k]; end
        if f4[k] > max4; max4 = f4[k]; end

        if f6[k] < min6; min6 = f6[k]; end
        if f6[k] > max6; max6 = f6[k]; end
    end

    r1 = (max1 - min1 < 1e-6) ? 1.0 : (max1 - min1)
    r2 = (max2 - min2 < 1e-6) ? 1.0 : (max2 - min2)
    r3 = (max3 - min3 < 1e-6) ? 1.0 : (max3 - min3)
    r4 = (max4 - min4 < 1e-6) ? 1.0 : (max4 - min4)
    r6 = (max6 - min6 < 1e-6) ? 1.0 : (max6 - min6)

    @inbounds for k in 1:n
        f1[k] = (f1[k] - min1) / r1
        f2[k] = (f2[k] - min2) / r2
        f3[k] = (f3[k] - min3) / r3
        f4[k] = (f4[k] - min4) / r4
        f6[k] = (f6[k] - min6) / r6
    end

    mode_val = rand(params.rng)

    if mode_val < 0.75
        # Mode 1: Randomized Multi-Attribute Priority Dispatch
        # Dynamically sample attribute weights per restart to explore diverse structured permutations
        w1 = 0.2 + 0.8 * rand(params.rng)         # Primary temporal priority (earliest pickup time)
        w2 = -0.8 + 1.0 * rand(params.rng)        # Request time span slack
        w3 = -0.8 + 1.0 * rand(params.rng)        # Pickup time window tightness
        w4 = -0.5 + 1.0 * rand(params.rng)        # Spatial pickup-delivery distance
        w5 = -0.5 + 1.3 * rand(params.rng)        # Inter-island / cross-floor priority
        w6 = -0.3 + 0.8 * rand(params.rng)        # Request demand magnitude

        noise_level = 0.01 + 0.12 * rand(params.rng)

        scores = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            jitter = rand(params.rng) * noise_level
            scores[k] = w1 * f1[k] + w2 * f2[k] + w3 * f3[k] + w4 * f4[k] + w5 * f5[k] + w6 * f6[k] + jitter
        end

        perm = sortperm(scores)

        result = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            result[k] = Int64(inst.V_p[perm[k]])
        end
        return result

    else
        # Mode 2: Floor-Grouped Temporal Lexicographic Sequencing
        # Process requests clustered by pickup floor with floor order perturbed by earliest pickup time
        unique_floors = unique(pz)
        num_floors = length(unique_floors)

        floor_offsets = Dict{Int64, Float64}()
        for z in unique_floors
            min_ep_z = 1e9
            @inbounds for k in 1:n
                if pz[k] == z && f1[k] < min_ep_z
                    min_ep_z = f1[k]
                end
            end
            floor_offsets[z] = min_ep_z + rand(params.rng) * 0.3
        end

        keys = Vector{Tuple{Float64, Float64, Float64, Float64}}(undef, n)
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            fl_off = floor_offsets[pz[k]]
            jitter = rand(params.rng) * 1e-4
            keys[k] = (fl_off, f1[k], f2[k], jitter)
        end

        perm = sortperm(keys)

        result = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
        @inbounds for k in 1:n
            result[k] = Int64(inst.V_p[perm[k]])
        end
        return result

    end

    # Step 1: Compute spatial centroid of all pickup locations
    sum_x = 0.0
    sum_y = 0.0
    min_e = Inf
    max_e = -Inf

    @inbounds for k in 1:n
        p = inst.V_p[k]
        jp = inst.jobs[p]
        x = Float64(jp.point.x)
        y = Float64(jp.point.y)
        e_p = Float64(inst.e[p])

        sum_x += x
        sum_y += y
        if e_p < min_e
            min_e = e_p
        end
        if e_p > max_e
            max_e = e_p
        end
    end

    center_x = sum_x / n
    center_y = sum_y / n
    time_span = max(max_e - min_e, 1e-5)

    # Determine dynamic time buckets (2 to 6 phases depending on instance size)
    num_phases = max(2, min(6, floor(Int64, sqrt(Float64(n)))))
    angle_offset = rand(params.rng) * 2.0 * pi

    # Step 2: Build lexicographic sweep key for each pickup-delivery request
    keys = Vector{Tuple{Int64, Int64, Int64, Float64, Float64, Float64}}(undef, n)

    @inbounds for k in 1:n
        p = inst.V_p[k]
        d = inst.V_d[k]

        p_y = Float64(jp.point.y)
        p_z = Int64(jp.point.z)

        e_p = Float64(inst.e[p])
        phase = clamp(floor(Int64, (e_p - min_e) / time_span * num_phases), 0, num_phases - 1)

        # Secondary priority: Pickup floor / island grouping
        floor_id = p_z

        # Tertiary priority: Inter-island moves prioritized before intra-island
        cross_island = (p_z != d_z) ? 0 : 1

        # Quaternary priority: Polar angle spatial sweep around centroid
        raw_angle = atan(p_y - center_y, p_x - center_x)
        sweep_angle = mod(raw_angle + angle_offset, 2.0 * pi)

        # Quinary priority: Tightest total pair slack
        slack = Float64(inst.l[d] - inst.e[p])

        # Hexary priority: Controlled jitter for multi-start variation
        jitter = rand(params.rng) * 1e-4

        keys[k] = (phase, floor_id, cross_island, sweep_angle, slack, jitter)
    end

    # Step 3: Sort requests by spatial-temporal sector sweep ordering
    perm = sortperm(keys)

    result = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
    @inbounds for k in 1:n
